source_text: De eo quod secundo populus numeratus est. Priore lectione exclusi sumus; nunc reddimus. Praecepto Domini primo numeratus est populus.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning that which secondly people numbered was. By-prior reading shut-out we-were; now we-render. By-precept of-Lord first numbered was people.
pass_b_english: On [[the second numbering of the people >> Bible:Numbers 26]]: earlier reading cut us short; we now make it good. By the Lord’s command the people were first numbered.
